{"consolidated_memory":"billing/invoice_totals.py - Off-by-one cent errors in totals calculator

COMMON SYMPTOM ACROSS OCCASIONS:
- File: billing/invoice_totals.py (billing side)
- Problem: off-by-one cent gap in totals calculator
- Signal: one cent gap in reconciliation report
- Repro: total an invoice with three prorated lines
- Stack: Python
- Test coverage: tests/billing/test_invoice_totals.py

OCCASION 1 [2026-04-09]:
- Trigger: affected only records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR #7855 on branch fix/off-by-one-cent-2
- Result: error rate dropped from 8.6 percent to under 1 per ten thousand

OCCASION 2 [2026-08-21]:
- Trigger: affected only clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- Root cause: error swallowed by a bare except handler
- Fix: narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #8338 on branch fix/off-by-one-cent-3
- Result: the backlog cleared 52 minutes after the deploy"}
